review.frame_coverage: 825 retained source frames at 24000/1001 fps in 14 camera segments. Title-only source72 removed; faint visible transition73 retained. Background partial microwave views retained. Both encoded streams have the same frame count and fps.
review.visual_review: All 9 encoded animation_v004 shot boards reviewed, then 20 additional animation_v005 encoded frames including both closures, cover lift and USB insertion. 794 unchanged render frames reused with recorded hashes; 31 second-closure frames rerendered.
review.revision: Native v084: rounded continuous cabinet/cavity, flush door, recessed blue control membrane, six function keys, sliding USB cover, hollow connector and black drive, horizontal handle, separate ceramic shelf, two front filter halves and unequal folding door stays.
review.mechanics: Bottom hinge. Closing events at171-182 and305-325; measured blurred free-edge lines plus inferred seating endpoints. USB cap lift494-498; drive approach524-554. USB axial depth and finger-occluded motion are inferred.
review.geometry: v084 cabinet manifold/positive volume, independent door, 2.2 mm membrane recess and feet checks passed. Door surfaces tested at11 angles and stays against cabinet/control/window at10 angles from0 to90 degrees; no tested overlaps. Pins, adjacent link coupling and latch engagement excluded. Not a continuous sweep or force test.
review.alignment_limit: Not pixel-perfect. Camera follows per-frame source similarity with manually fitted anchors. USB macro calibration has residuals up to about52 source pixels; blurred edges and sparse cropped background shots remain approximate. Source illustrated fascia has exaggerated vertical proportions; physical model proportions retained. Small printed symbols, material reflections, focus and source fades differ. People, food and filming environment are outside accepted scope.
review.scene: Frozen Tangyuan kitchen and shared external lighting. Interior lamp power inferred for visual presentation.
